deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

ignore_warnings.description: If true, allow backwards incompatible changes.
ignore_warnings.rationale: Allows breaking schema transitions when explicitly enabled; this is a compatibility/operations toggle, not an IAM or encryption setting—risk is mainly application breakage, not anonymous access.

instance.description: The name of the instance to create the schema bundle within.
instance.rationale: Instance reference for where the bundle is registered; not a secret token.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project ID for API scope; publicly inferable metadata, not a credential.

schema_bundle_id.description: The unique name of the schema bundle in the form '[_a-zA-Z0-9][-_.a-zA-Z0-9]*'.
schema_bundle_id.rationale: Bundle name only; naming does not embed credentials or replace authentication.

table.description: The name of the table to create the schema bundle within.
table.rationale: Table name linkage only; does not enumerate IAM members or expose row values.

proto_schema.description:
File descriptor set, generated by protoc.
To generate, use protoc with imports and source info included. For an example test.proto file, the following command would put the value in a new file named out.pb.

$ protoc --include_imports --include_source_info test.proto -o out.pb

proto_schema.proto_descriptors.description: Base64 encoded content of the file.
proto_schema.proto_descriptors.rationale: Encodes schema shape (descriptors) for validation; it is not live application data or an API key. Exposure risk is schema disclosure, not automatic data-plane access without IAM.
